messages:
rajeev: getting reports from apac about client cert rejections around 01:03 local. spike in TLS alerts on ingress. looks like 'certificate unknown' and backend unwrap denies showing up together
sara: I see lots of 495/496 from auth-proxy in the logs (client cert verification failures). simultaneously keystore logs show 'unwrap failed' for the same principal at nearly the same times. possible rotation race?
mike: paste a couple of logs? thinking about cert rotation timing vs key-alias swap in KMS
rajeev: logs (redacted):
```
auth-proxy[auth-12]: 2026-03-23T01:03:12+09:00 warn: tls: client certificate verification failed: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority client=svc-account:frontend-apac
keystore[rotator]: 2026-03-23T01:03:12+09:00 error: unwrap failed key=projects/redwood/keys/keystore-alpha err=403 KMSDecryptDenied principal=svc-account:frontend-apac
```

lina: timeline from audit: 2026-03-23T00:50 UTC a deploy rolled a new rotator container with cache disabled; 2026-03-23T00:58 UTC an infra change reassigned KMS alias keystore-alpha -> keystore-alpha-v2 (part of planned rotation). Looks like clients hitting different alias versions during handshake lead to unwrap inconsistencies
sara: so two contributors: 1) rotator cache disabled (no cached plaintext during transition) 2) alias reassignment meaning some unwraps require the new key version and RBAC for some SAs might not include decrypt for the new alias/version
mike: mitigations: 1) re-enable rotator cache as hotfix 2) rollback alias reassignment if possible 3) add temporary allow for svc-account:frontend-apac to decrypt both alias versions
oncall: applying cache-enable to rotator: kubectl set env deploy/rotator ROTATOR_CACHE_TTL=30s -n keystore --record :white_check_mark:
sec-bot: incident created INC-184201 by automated-alert: client-cert-rejects+keystore-failures in apac at 2026-03-23T01:06:00Z
rajeev: meanwhile patching KMS policy to give frontend-apac access to both keys (w/ expiration 2026-03-24T00:00Z) while infra validates alias propagation
sara: also enabling audit-level=decision on keystore service for 1h to capture exact deny reason and resource names
mike: note to infra: when rotating aliases, ensure role-mappings for all service-accounts cover both old and new key versions for a transition window. add canary that requests unwrap from each region before alias switch
lina: followups ticket SEC-2026-115 created: 1) reinstate rotator cache default 2) add alias-transition smoke test 3) RBAC change checklist to require dual-key access during rotation 4) add helix test that simulates 100 concurrent client cert handshakes while alias rotates
oncall: monitoring now shows client cert rejects dropping back to baseline over last 4m. keeping watch for 30m then will let infra schedule controlled alias re-swap with canary
rajeev: writing blameless summary after we stabilize. big thanks to everyone for rapid ops. will include exact audit ids and key alias mapping in the writeup :pray:
